ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Construct line EM $\parallel$ DC intersecting BC at M.\\
Since E is the midpoint of BD,\\
Thus EM$= \frac{1}{2}$DC=4.5\\
Since EM$\parallel$CA,\\
Thus $\triangle$EMF$\sim$$\triangle$ACF,\\
Thus $\frac{EF}{AF}=\frac{EM}{AC}=\frac{4.5}{15}=\frac{3}{10}$,\\
Thus $\frac{EF}{AE}=\boxed{\frac{3}{13}}$.
